goal: Write a screen that asks for camera permission, shows a live back-camera preview, and takes a photo when a button is pressed, displaying the captured image.
Write a module that asks for notification permission, schedules a local notification 60 seconds from now with a title and body, and makes notifications appear while the app is in the foreground.
Write a module that saves a JSON object to a file in the app's documents folder, reads it back, checks whether it exists, deletes it, and downloads a remote image into the cache folder.

Write a module that stores and reads an auth token in the device's secure storage, and opens a local SQLite database, creates a notes table if needed, inserts a note, and returns all notes as typed rows.
Write the root layout file for file-based routing: a tab bar with Home and Settings tabs with icons and titles, and redirect to a sign-in screen when there is no user.

Write a detail screen for the file-based route /items/[id]: read the id from the route, set the header title dynamically, link back to the list, and navigate programmatically to an edit screen with the id as a parameter.
Write a screen that shows a remote image with a blurred placeholder, a fade-in transition and disk caching, and displays the device's current coordinates after asking for location permission.

Write the dynamic app config file: name, slug, version, iOS bundle identifier, Android package, a camera usage description via the camera config plugin, and a different app name when an APP_VARIANT environment variable is set to development.
